## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 13 авг. 2026 г. - 22 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Leemiz_, 22 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Every three clicks on the app prompts it asking me to buy premium. No. I don’t want it and clicking so all the time is very very annoying"
            2. _Foody tracker_, 15 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Had this app for ages. Everything worked great then all off a sudden everything was behind a paywall and to scan my food I had to pay for the premium after using the app for years before."
            3. _Rhyssamuel06_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 3/5: "I’ve used this app for over 10 years to track my calories and it’s worked really well for me. Lately it seems more and more things are being locked behind the premium membership , some I can understand like the barcode scanner which is a real time saver , but lately they’ve changed meal macros to % instead of grams and then locked the option for grams behind the premium membership which I find completely ridiculous. The newer user interface is also far less intuitive than it used to be. Think it’s time for me to find another calorie counter"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      5 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 18 июн. 2026 г. - 22 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Jen,seeking resolution_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Terrible navigation, continually have Mondays entries end up on the following Sunday, no longer is there mass delete, various editing functions gone, way more clicks to add and delete, hideous UI and UX, glitchy. Did anyone bother to even do a feature gap analysis before deploying this junk that has had nothing but terrible reviews none of which have they remedied or even addressed? Boycot these people"
            2. _LoriLins64_, 16 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
            3. _Stage 8 and a half_, 13 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "The app is now almost unusable. The new UI is so unintuitive and cumbersome to navigate. It’s also much harder to see everything I’ve logged daily at a glance."
<!--/ir-theme-->
